title: part_2_extraction_readme.txt
content:
SPLIT PACKAGE — PART 2 OF 2

Source package: WorldBuilder+LifeSimulation_Enhanced.zip

This archive contains the matching Visual Studio and its supporting assets.

EXTRACTION:
1. Extract this archive into the SAME destination used for Part 1.
2. Allow the WorldBuilder+LifeSimulation folder to merge with the existing folder.
3. After both parts are extracted, the project structure matches the original complete package.

Part 1 contains the main simulator/editor, maps, globe systems, data, and launch files.
